name: What considerations should I make regarding maintenance for architectural millwork?

mainEntity.name: What considerations should I make regarding maintenance for architectural millwork?

acceptedAnswer.text: Maintenance for architectural millwork varies based on the materials and finishes used. Generally, regular dusting with a soft cloth is sufficient. For wood surfaces, avoid harsh chemical cleaners, which can damage the finish; instead, use mild wood-specific cleaners or a damp cloth followed by a dry one. Protect surfaces from excessive moisture and direct sunlight, which can cause warping or fading over time. Periodically check for any loose hardware or signs of wear. Proper care extends the life and preserves the beauty of your custom millwork, ensuring it remains a lasting feature in your space.
acceptedAnswer.description: Maintenance involves regular dusting, using appropriate cleaners for the material, and protecting surfaces from moisture and sunlight to preserve durability and appearance.
